translation_notes: Validation (type/shape checks, the required-key and required-`file` refusals) stays plain Python per row, so the loop header itself is a plain `for i, site in enumerate(sites, 1):`, not `for @bindings in`: the most specific fit here is `@bindings` (a mapping assigned per row) feeding `+{ }`, rather than forcing the raise-heavy body into the loop-of-mappings form.

The four unconditional triples (rdf:type, sv:citingFile, prov:wasDerivedFrom, sv:citedBy) become one multi-predicate `+{ }` bound from one @bindings mapping; the conditional fifth triple (sv:citingLine) is a second, separate `@bindings`/`+{ }` pair guarded by the same `if line is not None:` as the original, since a variable can't be left 'sometimes present' inside one block without also satisfying the well-formedness the original raises on.
DCTERMS, RDFS and OA are unused in this region (kept unused in original.py's imports too, matching the source file's module-level context).

Correction (réparation 2026-10-30) : l'original écrit (node, a, sv:CiteSite) avant de calculer `Literal(_text(file, …))`, qui peut lever ; la première traduction calculait le littéral avant tout ajout et n'avait pas le triplet rdf:type au moment de la levée (pilote renforcé : `file: ["x"]` en second site, 5 contre 4 triplets). Le type est maintenant ajouté par un `+{ {node} a sv:CiteSite }` à part, avant le dictionnaire de liaisons ; le graphe partiel est identique.

repair.driver: vingt appels au lieu de deux, avec comparaison du graphe partiel et de l'exception (type et message) : succès (cited_by null/absent/vide, line 0, file entier ou booléen, graphe prérempli, graphe portant une marque sur le noeud blanc du deuxième site pour rendre la numérotation observable) et chaque levée de l'original (cited_by non-liste dont "" et 0, site non-dict, une et deux clés inconnues, file absent/""/0, file non textuel en second site, line booléen/str/float) ; docstring qui dit ce que chaque appel exerce.

optimization_notes: optimized.py: the three triples written after the type become one `g += [...]` (the Literal is still computed after the type triple is added, so the partial graph left by a raising _text is unchanged); all guards and raises are kept. Little else to compress: the region is mostly validation.
